'''Andrew Mahone''' is a [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] competitor and online content creator. He is one of the most known players of Pokémon Trading Card Game history, being in notable spots at multiple [[World Championships]] and [[Play! Pokémon#Regional Championships|Regional Championships]].

After some Regional event results, Mahone became a writer of strategy articles for [[PokéBeach]] from 2015 to 2018, a Pokémon fansite focused on the card game. In 2017, he partnered with the Derium’s Competitive Pokemon YouTube channel as a TCG player, which was adapted in 2018 to his own YouTube and [[Twitch]] channels named Tricky Gym.<ref>[https://www.patreon.com/posts/new-developments-18206404 New Developments! - Patreon]</ref> The channel names are derived from the {{TCG ID|EX Team Rocket Returns|Rocket's Tricky Gym|90}} card from the {{TCG|EX Team Rocket Returns}} expansion.<ref>[https://www.patreon.com/posts/new-name-new-new-18820743 New Name, New Tier, New Playmat! - Patreon]</ref> These became some of the most popular sources of competitive Pokémon TCG content, where Mahone mainly showcases the game in tabletop or [[Pokémon Trading Card Game Live]] (formely [[Pokémon Trading Card Game Online]]) format. Mahone has also been featured in the official Pokémon [[YouTube]] channel on videos related to TCG strategies.

On July 31, 2024, the Pokémon TCG-themed reality show ''[[Pokémon: Trainer Tour]]'' was released, starring Mahone and fellow online content creator Meghan Camarena as hosts.

==Notable tournament performances==
* Top 8, [[2017 World Championships]]
* Top 16, [[2015 World Championships]]
* Top 8, [[Play! Pokémon#National Championships|2017 United States National Championships]]

==Notable decks used==
* {{TCG|Night March}} - 2015
* {{TCG|Yveltal/Garbodor}} - 2016
* {{TCG|Zoroark BREAK}} - 2017
* {{TCG|Gardevoir GX}} - 2017
* {{TCG|BuzzRoc}} - 2017
* {{TCG|PikaRom}} - 2019
* {{TCG|Miraidon ex}} - 2023
